import_scope: Research hypotheses only; historical price/news claims have not been independently reverified and are excluded.
execution_policy: Research only. No strategy, sizing, trading universe or promotion changes.

experiments.hypothesis: Compare existing signals with longs allowed only after both the dollar index and US two-year yield fell over the previous completed hour, and shorts only after both rose.
required_data: Timestamped original gold opportunities and their strategy version
Dollar index and US two-year yield observations available before each decision
experiments.validation: Freeze rules before chronological holdout; report original opportunities, kept and skipped trades, after-cost expectancy, drawdown, coverage and forward-paper results.

experiments.hypothesis: Compare GBP/USD and EUR/USD signals with prior completed-hour dollar-index confirmation. Separately tag documented yen intervention events; fixed historical price thresholds require revalidation.
experiments.validation: Freeze candidate definition and chronological holdout; report net results per original opportunity and session; do not merge different currency pairs' price units.

experiments.hypothesis: Compare continuation and reversal after the first completed 30-minute range following a weekend reopen.
required_data: Venue-specific futures bid/ask and trading calendar
experiments.validation: Treat futures and weekend CFDs separately; freeze gap/range rules before later-period holdout and include contract rolls and costs.

experiments.hypothesis: Compare immediate range breakouts with waiting for a completed 15-minute close outside a predefined range and a retest within four bars.
experiments.validation: Freeze range definition before holdout; avoid intrabar lookahead; include missed trades and costs per original opportunity.

experiments.hypothesis: Compare simulated SHIB returns with BTC over identical hours after venue-specific AUD conversion and fees.
required_data: Actual venue-specific AUD bid/ask for both assets
experiments.validation: Use the same holding periods and costs; no assumption that FOREX.com lists SHIB; report missing coverage and later-period holdout.

experiments.hypothesis: Measure the first observed quote where an existing entry would show a positive move after costs, and the worse entry price and remaining target distance if entering then.
required_data: Original entry/exit timestamps, fill, side and target
Fresh bid/ask observations received before original close
Full interval coverage and quote-gap audit
experiments.validation: The current replay describes historical timing only. A profitable original position at trigger time is not profit for the new entry. A strategy comparison also needs subsequent exits, stop ordering, missed trades, after-cost P&L and untouched chronological holdout.
